briefing: - 本批未见在野利用、勒索软件关联及公开PoC记录。
- 认证绕过/授权错误集中，5个CVSS 9.1漏洞需优先排查。
- 最急处置两条9.1认证绕过漏洞，立即修补并收紧鉴权。
- 批量公告以认证/授权类高发，兼有路径遍历与RCE风险。

items.title: 桌面授权码交换绕过双因素验证
items.title_zh: 桌面授权码交换绕过双因素验证
items.summary_zh: 掌握密码的攻击者可复用二次验证前签发的桌面授权码完成兑换，绕过双因素认证登录桌面端。
items.action_zh: 升级至含修复版本，并缩短授权码有效期、绑定设备与验证状态
items.repro_note: 需已知账号密码，截获二次验证前下发的授权码后重放兑换
items.impact_scope: 远程桌面接入认证入口，双因素防线
items.description: @better-auth/electron 1.5.0-beta.12 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 accepts any validly signed value as its transfer cookie and returns the full endpoint context, including the auth secret and social provider client secrets, in sign-in responses. Authenticated users can obtain these secrets to forge sessions as other users. Attackers knowing a password can exchange desktop authorization codes issued before two-factor verification to bypass the second factor.

items.title: fastify/express 空段认证绕过
items.title_zh: fastify/express 空段认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证客户端发送含空路径段的请求即命中受保护路由，跳过认证中间件直接访问处理器。
items.action_zh: 升级 @fastify/express 修复版本并核查中间件挂载
items.repro_note: 入口为动态挂载路径，插入空路径段使路由匹配而中间件跳过
items.impact_scope: Node Web框架兼容层，公网API服务
items.description: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. When a route and an Express middleware mount share a dynamic pattern, a request with an empty segment matches the Fastify route and runs the handler while the middleware mounted on that pattern is skipped, so on a scoped mount an unauthenticated request can reach a protected handler.

items.title: @fastify/middie 认证绕过
items.title_zh: @fastify/middie 认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 路由与中间件判定不一致，未认证客户端可跳过认证、授权或限流中间件直达受保护处理器。
items.action_zh: 升级 @fastify/middie 至官方修复版本
items.repro_note: 依赖中间件挂载与前缀路由，构造路径使路由命中而middie跳过
items.impact_scope: Node中间件引擎，公网API网关
items.description: @fastify/middie is the middleware engine for the Fastify web framework. When the two disagree, the router can route a request to a handler covered by a middleware mount while middie skips that middleware, so an unauthenticated client reaches a handler that an authentication, authorization, or rate-limiting middleware was meant to protect, with no special configuration required.

items.title: Dockhand envPath任意文件读写
items.title_zh: Dockhand envPath任意文件读写
items.summary_zh: 具stacks:edit权限的低权用户可将envPath指向敏感文件，通过env/raw接口读取或覆盖任意文件。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级到 1.0.57 及以上版本，校验envPath取值
items.repro_note: 需stacks:edit权限，设置envPath后访问/api/stacks/[name]/env/raw
items.impact_scope: 容器管理平台，内网运维中枢
items.description: Finsys Dockhand 1.0.7 before 1.0.57 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows low-privileged users to read and write arbitrary files by setting an unvalidated envPath on a stack source. Attackers with stacks:edit permission can point envPath to files like /etc/shadow or SSH keys, then use GET or PUT on /api/stacks/[name]/env/raw to read or overwrite them.

items.title: Express 中间件作用域认证绕过
items.title_zh: Express 中间件作用域认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 使用路径作用域认证中间件的前缀插件中，未认证客户端无需构造请求即可访问受保护路由。
items.action_zh: 升级 @fastify/express 修复版本，复核中间件挂载方式
items.repro_note: 需应用在带前缀插件内以路径作用域挂载认证中间件
items.impact_scope: Node后端服务，认证中间件失效面
items.description: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. An application that uses path-scoped Express middleware for authentication or authorization inside a prefixed plugin can expose protected routes to unauthenticated clients, with no crafted request and no non-default option required, and string, array, and regular-expression mount paths are all affected.

items.title: Express 正则挂载中间件认证绕过
items.title_zh: Express 正则挂载中间件认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 以正则表达式挂载认证中间件的应用，未认证客户端可跳过中间件访问受保护路由。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，改用非正则方式挂载中间件
items.repro_note: 需应用以正则挂载中间件于参数化前缀插件，构造匹配路径
items.impact_scope: Node后端服务，认证与限流绕过
items.description: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. As a result, Express silently skips that middleware while Fastify still runs the route handler, so an application that relies on regular-expression mounted middleware for authentication or authorization inside a parameterized-prefix plugin exposes protected routes to unauthenticated clients.

items.title: Grav 蓝图上传致Twig模板RCE
items.title_zh: Grav 蓝图上传致Twig模板RCE
items.summary_zh: 具备媒体与页面写权限的发布者可经blueprint-upload上传恶意模板，以Web服务用户身份执行命令。
items.action_zh: 升级 Grav API 插件到 1.1.4 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 需发布者账号，向blueprint-upload写入Twig模板并在页面中引用
items.impact_scope: Grav 站点管理后台，内容编辑入口
items.description: Grav API plugin from 1.0.0 before 1.1.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows publishers with media and page write rights to write theme template files through the blueprint-upload endpoint. Attackers can upload a file into a theme's Twig templates folder and include it from sandboxed page Twig to execute commands as the web-server user.

items.title: AzuraCast 注解转义致命令执行
items.title_zh: AzuraCast 注解转义致命令执行
items.summary_zh: 媒体管理员可设置以反斜杠结尾的ID3标题，注入process协议URI，在Liquidsoap容器内执行命令。
items.action_zh: 升级到 0.24.1 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 需媒体管理权限，上传含反斜杠结尾标题的音频并触发播放
items.impact_scope: 自建广播系统，常暴露于公网
items.description: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 fails to escape backslashes in Liquidsoap annotation values, allowing media managers to break out of quoted annotation strings. Attackers can set a crafted ID3 title ending in a backslash to inject a process: protocol URI, achieving OS command execution in the Liquidsoap container during playback.

items.title: better-auth手机号插件认证绕过
items.title_zh: better-auth手机号插件认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可先注册未验证手机号，受害者OTP登录时被选中该账户，导致登录身份错配
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至1.7.16或1.8.0-beta.5及以上版本
items.repro_note: 启用phoneNumber插件，注册他人未验证号码后走OTP登录流程
items.impact_scope: 认证基础库，波及所有接入方登录体系
items.description: better-auth 0.4.12-beta.7 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the phone number plugin that lets sign-up and other flows save unverified phone numbers, which phone OTP sign-in then uses to select the account. Attackers can attach a victim's number to an attacker-controlled account so the victim's valid OTP sign-in yields a session for that account, exposing data the victim then enters.

items.title: rclone SFTP认证绕过复用缓存
items.title_zh: rclone SFTP认证绕过复用缓存
items.summary_zh: 同IP且知晓受害者公钥者可将其当密码提交，命中缓存获取读写VFS权限
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至1.76.0，或临时停用serve sftp --auth-proxy
items.repro_note: 启用--auth-proxy的serve sftp，同IP提交公钥base64为密码
items.impact_scope: 文件传输网关，暴露公网易被滥用
items.description: Rclone from 1.51.0 before 1.76.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in serve sftp --auth-proxy because the generateCacheKey cache key omits the authentication method. Attackers knowing a victim's base64 public key can submit it as a password from the same client IP to reuse the cached entry and gain read-write VFS access.

items.title: Dockhand OIDC配置越权提权
items.title_zh: Dockhand OIDC配置越权提权
items.summary_zh: 持settings:edit权限的普通用户可改OIDC的adminClaim为自身组，下次登录即成管理员
items.action_zh: 升级至1.0.57，并收紧settings:edit授权范围
items.repro_note: 低权账户PUT /api/auth/oidc/<id>将adminClaim改为自身组
items.impact_scope: 容器管理平台，提权后可控制宿主机
items.description: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows non-admin users with settings:edit permission to modify OIDC provider configuration due to an improper permission check. Attackers can send a PUT request to /api/auth/oidc/<provider-id> setting adminClaim to their own OIDC group, gaining full admin access on their next OIDC login.

items.title: 数据库连接参数注入致命令执行
items.title_zh: 数据库连接参数注入致命令执行
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可操纵host/port/用户名/密码/库名等参数拼接系统命令，以应用权限执行任意指令。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 过滤并白名单校验连接参数，升级至厂商修复版本
items.repro_note: 入口为host/port/username/password/dbName，注入命令分隔符
items.impact_scope: 应用服务端连接组件，参数可被外部影响
items.description: A flaw has been found in jprocms up to 1.7.7. Affected is the function StrUtil.format of the component Database Backup Module. Executing a manipulation of the argument host/port/username/password/dbName can lead to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Express 未授权 CWE-174
items.description: @fastify/express is a compatibility layer that lets Express middleware run inside the Fastify web framework. An unauthenticated client can therefore reach a handler that an authentication, authorization, or rate-limiting middleware was meant to protect, with no special configuration required.

items.title: SurrealDB 桶ACL路径遍历读写
items.title_zh: SurrealDB 桶ACL路径遍历读写
items.summary_zh: 拥有桶访问权限的用户可用未规范化对象key绕过ACL校验，越权读写宿主机文件系统文件。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级到 4.0.0 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 需bucket权限，提交含..序列的未规范化对象key绕过ACL
items.impact_scope: 数据库服务，后端文件系统横向面
items.description: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in direct filesystem buckets because BucketController::check_permission evaluates key-based ACLs against the un-normalized object key, while FileStore::to_os_path collapses '..' sequences without a traversal check. An authenticated tenant permitted only for certain keys can supply a key such as /public/../private/confidential.txt to read, write, or delete arbitrary files within the storage root.

items.title: Admidio 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.description: Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Documents & Files renameFile() action that allows authenticated users with folder upload rights to move files outside adm_my_files by supplying ../ sequences in adm_new_name. Attackers can relocate an uploaded SVG containing script to the web root, where it is served inline and executes stored cross-site scripting against administrators for account takeover.

items.title: SurrealDB MCP反引号致SQL注入
items.title_zh: SurrealDB MCP反引号致SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用MCP服务标识符校验对反引号的误判，逃逸后注入SurrealQL语句越权查询数据。
items.action_zh: 升级到 4.0.0 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 入口为MCP server查询接口，构造反引号标识符绕过校验
items.impact_scope: 数据库MCP服务，AI代理后端组件
items.description: SurrealDB 3.1.0 before 4.0.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server because the identifier validator (consume_backtick_ident and validate_identifier) treats the first backtick as the closing delimiter, ignoring escape characters that the SurrealQL parser honors. Attackers can supply MCP tool arguments containing an escaped backtick to break out of the quoted identifier and execute arbitrary SurrealQL statements.

items.title: Frappe 附件处理路径遍历文件读取
items.title_zh: Frappe 附件处理路径遍历文件读取
items.summary_zh: 仅持普通角色且无写权限的已认证用户，可借附件处理构造路径读取应用边界外的服务器文件。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.repro_note: 登录普通角色账号，构造含../的附件请求路径读取系统文件
items.impact_scope: ERP低代码平台，内网核心业务系统
items.description: Frappe Framework before 15.120.1 and 16.x before 16.33.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in file attachment handling that permits arbitrary file read. Authenticated attackers holding a single ordinary role without write permissions can abuse attachment handling to read server files outside the application boundary.

items.title: ERPNext 销售采购接口SQL注入
items.title_zh: ERPNext 销售采购接口SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用调用方数据覆盖早期已校验的值，使未校验内容进入数据库查询，实现SQL注入。
items.repro_note: 入口为Selling/Buying模块端点，覆盖已校验请求值直达查询
items.impact_scope: ERP业务系统，内网核心数据库
items.description: Frappe ERPNext 4.3.0 before 15.121.6 and 16.x before 16.37.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in an endpoint of the Selling and Buying modules, where a request value validated early can be overridden by caller-supplied data that reaches a database query unvalidated. Any authenticated user, including a portal user with no roles, can send crafted requests to extract sensitive data, including active session data, and take over other accounts such as administrators.

items.title: ERP系统电子发票文件越权读取
items.title_zh: ERP系统电子发票文件越权读取
items.summary_zh: 持普通运营角色的认证用户可构造越界记录请求，读取其他公司的私密电子发票文件。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本并收紧记录级权限校验
items.repro_note: 需普通运营角色，构造越界记录名请求电子发票文件接口
items.impact_scope: ERP财务模块，多租户业务数据
items.description: Frappe ERPNext 11.1.7 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a Regional module endpoint that returns private e-invoice files after checking only document-type permissions, not per-record User Permissions. Authenticated attackers with a common operational role can send crafted requests naming out-of-scope records to read other companies' private e-invoice files.

items.title: ERP门户对账单文件越权读取
items.title_zh: ERP门户对账单文件越权读取
items.summary_zh: 门户用户甚至无角色账号即可提交越界记录请求，读取任意客户对账单文件全文。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，返回文件前校验记录归属
items.repro_note: 以门户用户或无角色账号登录，构造越界记录名请求对账单
items.impact_scope: ERP门户，面向外部与低权用户
items.description: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint that returns uploaded bank statement file content without checking record-level permissions. Authenticated attackers, including portal users or users with no assigned roles, can send crafted requests naming records outside their scope to read full statement file contents.

items.title: SurrealDB 桶内符号链接路径穿越
items.title_zh: SurrealDB 桶内符号链接路径穿越
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可借桶内预置符号链接通过词法前缀检查，读写宿主机文件系统上的任意文件。
items.action_zh: 升级到 4.0.0 及以上版本，并清理桶内软链接
items.repro_note: 需桶内已存在符号链接，构造可通过前缀检查的引用路径
items.impact_scope: 数据库存储层，宿主机文件系统
items.description: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in its filesystem storage bucket that only canonicalizes the bucket root, not descendant symlinks. Attackers can reference paths through a pre-existing symlink inside the bucket that pass the lexical prefix check, reading and writing files across the host filesystem.

items.title: SurrealDB Windows反斜杠穿越
items.title_zh: SurrealDB Windows反斜杠穿越
items.summary_zh: Windows部署下攻击者用含反斜杠的对象key绕过穿越检查，读取或篡改其他桶的文件。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级到 4.0.0，或避免在Windows上启用文件桶
items.repro_note: Windows部署，提交 /..\bucket2\secret 形式对象key
items.impact_scope: Windows上的数据库服务，跨桶数据
items.description: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in its bucket storage layer on Windows, where ObjectKey::check_no_traversal splits object keys only on forward slashes while FileStore::to_os_path treats backslashes as directory separators. Attackers can supply object keys such as /..\bucket2\secret to bypass the traversal check and read or modify files in other buckets.

items.title: Surya购物系统p参数SQL注入
items.title_zh: Surya购物系统p参数SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者通过p参数将恶意语句带入数据库查询，可读取或篡改系统中的业务数据。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商获取修复版本，对p参数做白名单校验
items.repro_note: 入口为p查询参数，构造注入载荷直接进入SQL查询
items.impact_scope: 中小型电商站点，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in Surya2Developer Online Shopping System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file product.php of the component GET Parameter Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument p results in sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: Admidio 文件重命名路径遍历
items.title_zh: Admidio 文件重命名路径遍历
items.summary_zh: 已认证用户提交未校验的adm_new_name，可将文件移动至adm_my_files目录之外。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级到 5.0.18 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 需登录账号，向重命名接口提交含../的adm_new_name参数
items.impact_scope: 协会成员管理CMS，内外网均可部署
items.description: Admidio from 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains a path traversal vulnerability in DocumentsService::renameFile() that allows authenticated users to move files outside adm_my_files by supplying an unvalidated adm_new_name value. Attackers with folder upload permission can submit ../ sequences to file_rename_save to write files and create directories in arbitrary writable locations, including the web root.

items.title: AMD RAS SMM驱动SMRAM越权写入
items.title_zh: AMD RAS SMM驱动SMRAM越权写入
items.summary_zh: 具高权限的本地攻击者利用输入校验缺陷覆盖SMRAM，可进一步实现任意代码执行。
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需高权限)
items.action_zh: 更新主板或芯片组BIOS至含修复的版本
items.impact_scope: AMD平台终端固件层，需本地高权限
items.description: Improper input validation within the AmdPlatformRasSmm driver could allow an attacker with privileged access to overwrite SMRAM, potentially resulting in arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Gammapy FITS头注入代码执行
items.title_zh: Gammapy FITS头注入代码执行
items.summary_zh: 诱导用户用Map.read加载恶意.fits，WCSSHAPE中表达式被eval执行
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至2.2及以上，勿加载来源不明FITS文件
items.repro_note: 构造WCSSHAPE含Python表达式的.fits，经Map.read解析
items.impact_scope: 科研数据处理环境，多为内网工作站
items.description: Gammapy through 2.1 contains a code injection vulnerability in WcsGeom.from_header() that passes the WCSSHAPE FITS header card to eval(). Attackers can supply a crafted .fits file with a Python expression in WCSSHAPE, executing code as the user who loads it via Map.read().

items.title: OpenShot工程文件反序列化RCE
items.title_zh: OpenShot工程文件反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 诱骗用户打开恶意.osp工程文件，pickle反序列化以用户权限执行代码
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 勿打开来源不明.osp，跟踪官方修复版本并及时升级
items.repro_note: 构造含__reduce__利用链的非JSON .osp，经项目加载触发
items.impact_scope: 桌面剪辑软件，主要威胁终端用户
items.description: OpenShot Video Editor (openshot-qt) through 4.1.1 contains an unsafe deserialization vulnerability in ProjectDataStore.load() and read_legacy_project_file() that passes non-JSON project files to pickle.load() without restriction. Attackers can trick users into opening a crafted .osp project file containing a pickle __reduce__ gadget to execute code with the user's privileges.

items.title: OpenRemote MQTT设备认证绕过
items.title_zh: OpenRemote MQTT设备认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者无需持有私钥即可冒充已预置设备接入MQTT通道
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至1.34.0及以上版本
items.repro_note: 以已注册设备标识连接MQTT，走UserAssetProvisioning流程鉴权
items.impact_scope: IoT管理平台，设备接入面暴露公网
items.description: OpenRemote core before 1.34.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in UserAssetProvisioningMQTTHandler that allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate provisioned devices without proof of private key possession. Attackers can publish a known device's public certificate to the provisioning request topic, authenticating their anonymous MQTT connection as the device's service account to read and modify assets.

items.title: SiYuan 资源接口越权读取加密文档
items.title_zh: SiYuan 资源接口越权读取加密文档
items.summary_zh: 匿名者利用资源名碰撞绕过保护，读取设密文档的附件内容
items.action_zh: 升级至3.8.10及以上版本
items.repro_note: 匿名请求serveAssets，构造与受保护资源同名的路径
items.impact_scope: 自托管知识库，常见于内网个人/团队
items.description: SiYuan 3.8.0 before 3.8.10 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the serveAssets route that allows unauthenticated attackers to read password-protected document assets via name collisions. Attackers can request GET /assets/<name> when a visible document references the same relative asset name, retrieving the protected file's contents on public-publish instances with Basic Auth disabled.

items.title: SiYuan getDOMText缺失授权
items.title_zh: SiYuan getDOMText缺失授权
items.summary_zh: 匿名调用该接口渲染引用图片路径，绕过发布校验读取未公开图片资源
items.action_zh: 升级至3.8.10及以上版本
items.repro_note: 匿名POST /api/block/getDOMText，传入未发布图片路径
items.impact_scope: 自托管知识库，内网部署普遍
items.description: SiYuan 3.6.0 before 3.6.2 and 3.7.3 before 3.8.10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the /api/block/getDOMText endpoint, which renders caller-supplied DOM without checking publish access for referenced image paths. When publish authentication is disabled, anonymous visitors can submit DOM referencing a known unpublished, non-encrypted asset path to retrieve its already-cached OCR text.

items.title: SiYuan 资源索引越权泄露文本
items.title_zh: SiYuan 资源索引越权泄露文本
items.summary_zh: 匿名者先取公开文档资源路径，再查索引接口获取保密文件全文
items.action_zh: 升级至3.8.10及以上版本
items.repro_note: POST /api/asset/getDocAssets取路径后调getAssetContentByPath
items.impact_scope: 自托管知识库，内网敏感资料载体
items.description: SiYuan 3.8.0 before 3.8.10 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows anonymous attackers to read indexed asset text referenced only by publish-disabled attribute-view rows. Attackers can request /api/asset/getDocAssets on a public host document to obtain the leaked asset path, then query /api/search/getAssetContentByPath to retrieve the confidential file's full indexed text.

items.title: SiYuan 伪造XFF绕过认证
items.title_zh: SiYuan 伪造XFF绕过认证
items.summary_zh: 经回环可信反代伪造X-Forwarded-For为127.0.0.1，未设锁屏密码时读笔记历史
items.action_zh: 升级至3.8.10，勿信任外部XFF并设置锁屏密码
items.repro_note: Host=localhost、XFF=127.0.0.1请求/history/*path
items.impact_scope: 自托管知识库，反代部署场景需警惕
items.description: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain Administrator role by spoofing X-Forwarded-For through a loopback-trusted reverse proxy. Attackers can send requests with Host set to localhost and X-Forwarded-For set to 127.0.0.1 to read private note-history contents via the /history/*path route when no lock-screen password is set.

items.title: WeddingShare 未授权 缺失授权(越权)
items.description: WeddingShare through 1.8.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the anonymous MediaViewerController.GalleryItem action that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve item upload paths without the gallery secret key. Attackers can enumerate sequential integer item ids to learn paths and uploader names, then download photos and videos from key-protected galleries served as static files.

items.title: 未授权 大小写处理不一致
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: An unauthenticated client can therefore reach a handler that an authentication, authorization, or rate-limiting middleware was meant to protect, though only when the application enables case-insensitive routing and the mount path contains an affected letter.

items.title: PSP Boot ROM 签名校验错误
items.description: Improper verification of a cryptographic signature in the PSP Boot ROM of AMD Zeppelin (Zen1/Zen+) processors could allow an attacker with local access to the SPI flash to bypass secure boot authentication, potentially resulting in arbitrary unsigned code execution at full Platform Security Processor privilege, loss of confidentiality, loss of integrity of the host boot chain, and persistent loss of availability.

items.title: 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in eigent-ai eigent up to 1.0.2. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file backend/app/controller/chat_controller.py of the component Local Agent Control API. Performing a manipulation results in missing authentication. The attack may be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 1.0.3 addresses this issue. The patch is named 59f43afcb1b0ba7b2de8c65d585124f196c4aa17. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.
